text: The General Assembly will hear an
address by Mr. Benjamin Netanyahu,
Prime Minister of the State of Israel.
I request the protocol team to escort
him and invite him to address the
General Assembly. 2 2 I ask for order
in the hall. Thank you, Mr. President.
Before I begin, just a brief
announcement: if there are any moral
cowards remaining in this hall, please
leave now. Thank you very much. Ladies
and gentlemen, 14 years ago, I stood on
this podium and drew a red line. I
vowed to prevent Iran's murderous
dictatorship from developing atomic
bombs. Nuclear weapons aimed at
destroying Israel. Nuclear weapons that
could threaten the entire world. That
is exactly what we did. Now, let me say
something that may surprise you.
Destroying Iran's nuclear facilities is
difficult, very difficult to do. But
for me, it was one of the easiest
decisions I have ever had to make as
Prime Minister. Because if we had not
done so, we would all be dead. Now, you
want to hear the ultimate irony in
Israel defending itself? Israel is also
protecting many nations whose
representatives just walked out of this
hall. In fact, I want you to know that
many of their leaders even secretly
thank us for eliminating Iran's nuclear
weapons. It is hard to imagine a more
stunning hypocrisy than that. But that
is exactly what is happening. This is
not the first time we have faced the
threat of annihilation. On June 5, 1967
, Israel was surrounded by enemies
openly swearing to destroy us. Back
then, we were not in Judea and Samaria,
the heartland of the historic Jewish
homeland. We were not in Gaza. We were
not in the Golan Heights. And the Gaza
Strip. You should know that the Jews
have been in the Golan since the time
of Moses. You can read it in the Bible.
At that time, on the eve of the 1967
Six-Day War, we were not in any of
those places. We were just in a small
strip of land, and that remains the
case today. That area is about 1/3 of 1
%of the entire Arab world. Yet they
accuse Israel. A tiny Israel is
colonialism. And who is accusing us?
Among them are people in Britain and
France. For God's sake, they invented
the term themselves. Their colonies
spanned the entire globe. Colonialism,
really? Give us a break. And that is
another lie. But at that time, on this
tiny piece of land, there was no West
Bank, no Gaza, no Golan Heights, only
the existence of one and only one
Jewish state. Because that is what this
conflict is all about. It is not about
territory, it is about the existence of
a Jewish state regardless of the
borders. And at that very moment, we
were threatened with annihilation by
three Arab armies that were preparing
to invade us. Do you know what Israelis
were doing then? They were digging mass
graves to prepare for thousands and
thousands of casualties, preparing to
bury the dead. I was an Israeli high
school student in Philadelphia,
Pennsylvania, at the time. Five days
before the war broke out, I flew back
to Israel. I saw a country completely
plunged into darkness. Israel was
preparing for the attack. I flew back
to see my brother Jonathan. Jonathan,
Yoni. He was a 21-year-old paratrooper
officer, and like the rest of the army,
his unit had been mobilized. I went
looking for him. I was told that the
paratrooper units were stationed in the
orchards, the orange groves around
Ramla. So I went there and asked some
soldiers, "Do you know where Yoni
Netanyahu is?" No. No. Then one said, "
Oh, you mean that young guy?""Yes, he
is in the next orchard." So I went
there, and suddenly, at the end of a
long row of trees, I saw my brother. He
was completely stunned to see me. "Bibi
," he said, "Bibi, what are you doing
here?" We ran and hugged each other,
and over a cup of quickly brewed army
coffee, I asked him the question that
was on my mind. The question was on
everyone's mind. Yoni said, "What will
happen? He paused and then said
something I have never forgotten. We
will win. He said we have no other
choice. I remember those words as if it
were yesterday. We will win. We have no
other choice. And when we won nine
years later, Palestinian terrorists
hijacked a passenger plane heading to
Israel. They took the plane to Entebbe,
Uganda. Like the Nazis, the terrorists
singled out Jewish passengers, men,
women, children, infants. They
threatened to kill them all if
Palestinian terrorists were not
released. And then on July 4, 1976,
right on the American bicentennial, in
one of the most spectacular rescue
missions in modern times, Yoni led his
brave soldiers into the heart of Africa
. Miraculously, they rescued 103 Jewish
hostages and brought them all back home
, every single one. My brother, who led
the raid, was the only soldier killed
in that operation. I want to once again
thank Uganda for recently accepting a
statue of Yoni at the place where he
fell. My friends, Yoni's words today
remain as true as they were over half a
century ago. We will win, we have no
other choice. At no time was this more
clearly proven than on October 7, 2023,
the darkest day in Israel's history. On
that horrific day, thousands of
Palestinian terrorists swarmed from
Gaza into Israel. I want you to know
that at the time, there was not a
single Israeli in Gaza. Not a civilian,
not a soldier, no one. But that meant
nothing. Hamas terrorists carried out
the worst massacre of Jews since the
Holocaust. They went from house to
house, shooting Israeli civilians at
point-blank range. They did it with
gloating, with sadistic joy. They
livestreamed the murders. And whom did
they kill? The very Israelis, their
neighbors, the people who gave them
jobs, who took Palestinian children at
the Gaza border and brought them to
Israeli hospitals for cancer treatment,
and then brought them back. Can you
imagine such monstrosity? These Hamas
monsters murdered Holocaust survivors.
They burned infants alive in front of
their parents. They beheaded our men.
They brutally raped our women. And then
they murdered them. In total, they
massacred 1,200 Israelis that day. I
want to show you what this means for a
nation of 10 million people.
Proportionally, this is equivalent to
40,000 innocent Americans being
massacred in less than 24 hours. That
is 16 times September 11th. 16
September 11ths that happened not far
from here. On that darkest of days, our
enemies expected us to collapse, but we
did not collapse. Instead, we stood up
and fought like lions. For the past
three years, our heroic soldiers have
fought day after day in a seven-front
war. Do you know any country the size
of New Jersey capable of fighting on
seven fronts? In three years, seven
fronts: Hamas, Houthis, Iran, militias
in Iraq, militias in Syria, and
Palestinian terrorists in Judea and
Samaria, all joined together to wipe us
off the map. They failed because
instead of collapsing, we dealt
crushing blows to all of them. Together
with our great American friends, we
have crushed Iran's army, navy, air
force, and nuclear facilities. Israel
has dealt strong blows to Hamas. We
have crushed them. You remember the
pagers? Remember those things? I can
tell you this. Hezbollah certainly
remembers them. Guess what happened to
the majority of their massive arsenal
of 150,000 missiles and rockets. All
aimed at our civilians. They are gone.
Hezbollah's leaders are dead. Their
spirit is broken. The top terrorists,
the worst mass murderers on earth,
killed not only Israelis but also
Americans, killed the British, and
killed citizens of dozens of other
countries. Khamenei, Deif, Haniyeh,
Nasrallah, and thousands of other
terrorists sought to destroy us. They
have all been eliminated. The remaining
terrorists are desperately trying to
regroup. Every single day, they try to
murder our people. In particular, they
try to murder our people in our
historic homeland of Judea. By the way,
that is where the word" Jew "comes from
. Judea, that is our land. They are
seeking to murder us. Thousands of
attacks every year are aimed at
families. Peaceful families driving on
the road; they shoot at pregnant women,
they shoot at entire families. Of
course, none of this is covered by
international media or social media—
none of it. What they report is a small
group of juvenile delinquents, about
150 people. Those who throw stones,
sometimes cut down olive trees,
sometimes set fires. I cannot accept
that. I will not tolerate vigilantism.
We are a nation of law, so we brought
in the Shin Bet to handle them. But
that is what they call" settler
violence. "And the number of people
killed each year. Perhaps two or three
in this entire period being discussed.
Perhaps two or three deaths. Compared
to thousands of terrorist attacks aimed
at peaceful settlers. Respectable,
law-abiding people—what a distortion.
It is an obsession. I hear this
discussion here. I mean, leaders of
serious countries talking about it, and
they say with such gravity that" we
cannot accept settler violence. "You do
not know what you are talking about.
And listen, two days ago I said this to
my colleague, Emmanuel Macron, a French
citizen, Nataniel Young, a father of
six, was shot dead when he visited a
spring with his 16-year-old son. A
Hamas terrorist in Judea and Samaria
walked up and shot him point-blank. The
last words he uttered were run, run my
son, save yourself. That was two or
three days ago. Two days ago in Judea
and Samaria, a reserve officer, a
reservist named Nara was shot by a
Palestinian terrorist in a drive-by
shooting. He is now fighting for his
life in a hospital in Jerusalem. I
visited his family right before getting
on the plane to come here. Nara, a
father of four, is the son of Ler, our
distinguished ambassador to the United
States. Three years ago, the eldest son
of Mos, a father of six, was killed
while clearing a booby-trapped building
in Gaza. Du, my brother, your pain is
immeasurable. All Israelis and many
people outside of Israel are praying
for Nara's life. But despite the pain,
despite the agony, we do not surrender.
In a recent post before the attack,
Nara wrote:" Listen to this. We have no
other country. Defending this country
is a privilege. "To Nara and all of
Israel's heroes, I make a sacred vow.
Your sacrifice will not be in vain. We
will continue to defend our country. We
will continue to win because we have no
other choice. In the fight against
these barbarians, we have no greater
partner than President Trump. I thank
you. I thank you for your bold
leadership. You have courageously
confronted a colossal danger to America
, Israel, and the world. Decades ago,
you understood that if left
unchallenged, the fanatical Ayatollahs,
who chant death to America, death to
Israel, would eventually realize their
insane delusions. So, Israel and
America acted together not only to
protect ourselves but to save
civilization. Brave American pilots
alongside brave pilots carried out
joint missions in the skies over Iran.
America and Israel also coordinated to
bring home our remaining hostages. We
brought every last one of them home.
You ask why we are winning? Joni said
it simply because we have no other
choice. And throughout this long war,
our goal has never changed: to win. To
win with unwavering resolve, to win
with relentless courage. Because this
is Israel, a nation fighting for a
future, left and right, young and old,
religious and secular. Do we have
differences? Of course we do, who
doesn’t? But in critical moments,
moments that shape our destiny, we
stand together because what unites us
is so much stronger. That is our
history, our values, our courage. The
courage of the brave people who endured
a thousand massive ballistic missiles
that Iran rained down on our cities, on
our civilians. You are sitting in the
UN General Assembly hall, do you know
what a 1-ton ballistic missile, just
one, would do if it hit this place? It
would flatten the entire complex. In
fact, two such missiles would flatten
the United Nations. So you can imagine,
think about 1,000 massive missiles
falling from the sky onto your cities,
onto your homes. I salute the courage
of the people of Israel. I salute the
courage of our brave soldiers. Jews,
Christians, Muslims, the most moral
army in the world, the IDF. For three
years, our brave soldiers have fought
valiantly in a war on seven fronts. But
there is another front in this war, the
battle for the truth. It takes place in
the world media and, most dangerously,
on social media. Some foreign countries
have spent vast, incalculable sums of
money to spread lies about my country.
The first country to do so was Qatar.
Decades ago, it began large-scale
funding of American universities and
toxic media outlets like Al Jazeera. By
the way, they are doing the same thing
in Europe. Their goal is very clear is
to brainwash young minds to hate Israel
, hate America, hate the West. This is
Qatar, the country that harbors the
Hamas butchers of October 7th. Now, the
newest country to become a
super-spreader of antisemitic lies is
Turkey. Erdogan. Erdogan is a tyrant.
He also harbors Hamas terrorist leaders
. He has slaughtered thousands of
Kurdish civilians. He denies the
Armenian genocide. He imprisons
journalists and opposition leaders.
Actually, I think he holds the world
record for this. It’s a tough choice.
But I think he’s number one. He
illegally occupies Northern Cyprus, an
EU member, and frequently violates
Greece, a NATO member. Now he wants to
control Syria. It is not surprising
because he calls for the destruction of
Israel almost every day. He says he
will become the ruler of Jerusalem. No,
sir, you will not. That is our land,
our city, our eternal capital. Tyrants
all over the world seek to threaten us.
They seek to weaken our resolve with a
campaign of lies. But ultimately, just
as on the military battlefield, the
Jewish people will prevail. It will
take time; it will take time to defeat
the lies. It will take time for the
world to acknowledge what is so obvious
before their eyes. Hamas has used
Palestinian civilians as human shields.
They use hospitals, schools, and
mosques as terrorist command centers.
They have stolen most of the food that
we bring into Gaza. And while Hamas
does everything it can to keep
Palestinian civilians in harm's way,
often at gunpoint, Israel has done
everything it can to get them out of
harm's way. We send millions of
messages warning civilians to leave
combat zones. We make millions of phone
calls. We drop millions of flyers. I
want to ask you a few questions. What
genocidal regime would administer 1
million polio vaccine doses to an enemy
population? What kind of genocide
allows for the distribution of 2
million tons of food into Gaza? That is
one ton for every single person. The
accusation of genocide against Israel
is the biggest lie of the century. If
you want to know how big that lie is,
if you want to know how absurd it is,
listen to Colonel John Spencer. He is
the head of urban warfare studies at
West Point. He is considered one of, if
not the world's leading expert on urban
warfare. I believe he is with us here
today. Colonel Spencer. Colonel Spencer
has studied every urban war from
ancient to modern times, from classical
Greece to Mosul and Gaza. And this is
what Colonel Spencer says. Israel has
done more than any other military in
history to prevent civilian casualties
in war. In history, we have taken
countless measures to protect civilians
. Is that genocide? Of course not. It
is the exact opposite of genocide. So,
to all those spreading these lies about
my country and our brave soldiers,
whether they sit in this hall or in the
office of the antisemitic mayor of New
York, I say this. Shame on you. Shame
on you for distorting the truth. Shame
on you for reversing the victim and the
aggressor. Shame on you for spitting on
the truth. Adams, since you were
elected mayor of this city, many Jews
no longer feel safe in New York. They
talk to me, they say this is not the
city we once knew, it has changed too
fast. Now, that is not surprising at
all. You praise criminals convicted for
supporting Hamas. You count people like
Hassan as friends, who once said
America deserved 9/11. Some of the
friends you have, you invited into your
home a Palestinian journalist who
filmed Hamas terrorists beating and
torturing Israeli hostages, then
admitted that he refused to release the
videos to protect. You guessed it, the
terrorists. Your wife liked a post
praising the October 7th massacre. She
liked another post saying that Tel Aviv
should not exist. You refuse to condemn
any of that. You repeatedly and falsely
accuse Israel of genocide. Mamdani, you
tried to stop me from coming here. You
tried to silence me, but you cannot
silence me. You cannot silence the
truth. And here is the simple truth.
Israel is not committing genocide.
Israel is preventing genocide. And that
is exactly what Mamdani's Hamas friends
would do to us if we didn't stop them;
they would kill every last one of us.
The lies that you and other antisemites
spread about Jews and the Jewish state
have real consequences. In New York,
Jews are threatened on their way to the
synagogue. Jews have been stabbed on
the street. Jews are demonized, they
are targeted. They are targeted simply
for being Jewish. Jews have been
murdered in Sydney, Manchester,
Montreal, Boulder, Colorado. They are
attacked in Los Angeles, London, Paris,
Berlin, Washington D.C. Antisemites
around the world want to terrorize our
people. I have news for them. The days
when Jews were defenseless victims
being led to the slaughter are over.
Today we have a state. Today we have an
army. Today we have a people ready and
determined to defend ourselves. So
today I have a message for Jews all
over the world. Hold your head high, be
proud, be confident, don't be
intimidated, and stand up and speak to
everyone else. All who want to defend
truth and justice, join us in standing
against the barbarians who threaten our
common civilization. But I have to be
honest with you, not everyone is
standing up. We have seen that. Because
unlike Israel, there are some countries
, especially recently in Western Europe
, that have chosen not to stand up. The
leaders of these countries have chosen
to bow to the antisemitic mobs. They
have chosen weakness. They have chosen
a policy of appeasement. We cannot
avoid the sad truth before us. Many in
the free world are afraid to defend
freedom. And I ask them, what future
will this behavior, this world, bring
you? A brotherhood of democracies or a
Muslim brotherhood? How much longer
will it take you to realize that these
fanatics are choking your waterways,
energy supplies, and economic lifelines
? I can assure you, we in Israel will
not wait for others to wake from their
moral slumber. We move forward, we
embrace the future. We are pioneering
incredible advancements in medicine,
agriculture, and artificial
intelligence, and we bring these
amazing innovations to all of humanity.
Therefore, Israel has never been
stronger. We are not afraid, but I will
tell you who is afraid: the tyrants in
Tehran themselves. And do you know what
? They fear their own people most of
all. The brave people of Iran have
sacrificed so much for so long. The
Iranian regime is especially afraid
when their people have this. When their
people have this. This is a Starlink
communication device that allows people
to access the truth, exercise their
right to choose, and exercise their
freedom of thought and speech. That is
why the Iranian regime spends millions
and billions of dollars to censor the
Internet. Mr. President, I will leave
this device with you so you can give it
to the Iranian delegation. So that when
they inevitably defect, they too can
freely tell their stories on social
media. To the protesters outside, to
the hypocritical delegates who walked
out on us, I ask you: where were you
when the Iranian tyrants murdered? And
wounded tens of thousands of unarmed
Iranian civilians, when they murdered
and wounded thousands of their own
people? Where were you? Did you
organize mass marches? Did you go on
hunger strikes? Did you protest outside
the Iranian mission to the United
Nations? Did you speak up for the
persecuted Christians in Iran and
across the Middle East? No, you don't,
because you are fake human rights
protesters. Regarding Christians, you
know their numbers are plummeting
across the Middle East, where they are
persecuted and hunted down, except in
one place: my country, Israel, where
the Christian community is thriving and
successful. In fact, you didn't protest
when we left Bethlehem, which was under
our control. At that time, it was 80 to
90%Christian, and we handed it over to
the Palestinian Authority. Today, it is
80 to 90%Muslim. The Christians were
pushed out. Did you protest that? Did
you speak out about that? Nothing at
all. And you say nothing about Iran
either. You say nothing about Iran. But
I want to bring you some good news.
Despite your silence, despite your
hypocrisy, it is only a matter of time.
Before in Iran, something amazing
happens. The power of the people will
overcome those in power. I want you to
listen to my words carefully. One day,
and it may not be far off, the people
of Iran will be free. Their murderous
regime will be toppled by its own lies,
by its corruption, and by its brutality
. This evil regime will fall, and we
will all celebrate that day. Ladies and
gentlemen, the story of my people, the
Jewish people, has spanned over 3,000
years. We speak the same language.
Today, we speak the same language that
we spoke back then. We live on the same
land where our ancestors once lived.
David, Solomon, Isaiah, Jeremiah. It is
our land, the land of Israel, our
prophets, our purpose, and our people
are unique in history. Our values have
inspired humanity for millennia. Belief
in one God, the sanctity of life, the
rule of law. The eternal longing for
peace, the eternal longing for justice.
It is those very sacred values that
have propelled us through the ages. It
is precisely those values that have
helped us overcome the trials of
history. The great American writer Mark
Twain said it best 125 years ago. He
said it long before the modern Jewish
state was re-established. Long before
the great victories of the Israeli
soldiers. This is what he said. The Jew
has made a marvelous fight in this
world in all the ages. And he has done
it with his hands tied behind his back.
The Egyptian, the Babylonian and the
Persian rose, filled the planet with
sound and splendor, then faded to
dream-stuff and passed away. Other
peoples have sprung up and held their
torch high for a time. But it burned
out and they sit in the twilight. The
Jew saw them all, beat them all, and is
now what he always was. Exhibiting no
decay, no infirmity of age, no weakness
of his parts, no slowing of his
energies. Ladies and gentlemen, over
the centuries, the tyrants who sought
to destroy us have failed time and time
again. And God willing, they will
continue to fail. If we summon the
courage, if we harden our resolve, we
will continue to prevail. As the Bible
says, the Eternity of Israel will not
waver. And the reason is simple, we
have no other choice. Thank you all
very much. On behalf of the General
Assembly, I thank the Prime Minister of
the State of Israel. Amen. To the Prime
Minister of the State of Israel. Mm.
